mappingNotes: All SQLite INTEGER/BIGINT values map to PostgreSQL BIGINT; flags remain integer values, JSON and timestamps remain text.
A single-column INTEGER primary key maps to GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, preserving explicit source IDs on import.
Foreign keys, delete/update actions, deferral, unique keys and checks are native constraints; explicit indexes preserve their source names.
SQLite integer predicates in partial indexes and the sales review check use explicit comparisons to zero.

savia_json_valid uses the PostgreSQL json parser while retaining text storage. JSON execution uses jsonb and therefore escaped U+0000 is a known incompatible value requiring resolution before release.
seed=false suppresses baseline seed data permanently for that installation; changing seed on an applied baseline never replays seeds.
